passing_rule: Award one point for each fully met criterion. Pass requires 3/3, a citation to the 2023 Form 8-K covering the claims, and no material factual or cutoff errors. Accept accurate paraphrases.

criteria.requirement: Disney expected to pay NBCUniversal about USD 8.61 billion on or before 1 December 2023, assuming all outstanding NBCUniversal capital call contributions remained unpaid on that date. The figure was an initial payment estimate as of the cutoff.
USD 27.5 billion was the guaranteed floor for the equity value of all of Hulu. NBCUniversal’s equity ownership percentage was applied to the applicable total equity value.

The agreed appraisal could lead to an additional payment to NBCUniversal if Hulu’s final appraised equity value exceeded the floor. The appraisal and final purchase price were still unresolved on 2 November 2023.

anchors: greater than the guaranteed floor value

later_outcome.summary: Disney reported that it paid about USD 8.6 billion in December 2023 and that an additional USD 438.7 million was payable after the contractual appraisal concluded on 9 June 2025. Use this disclosure to spot hindsight in a response. The June 2025 filing falls outside the answer’s cutoff.

examples_of_errors: Calling USD 8.61 billion the final purchase price or saying Disney had already paid it by the cutoff.
Calling USD 27.5 billion the purchase price for NBCUniversal’s stake.
Omitting the assumption about the unpaid contributions or saying the appraisal could not affect what Disney owed.
Presenting the USD 438.7 million appraisal outcome as known in November 2023, even if the figure is accurate.
